job: Ask Ember AI, reach a person, or read a past conversation, with the service status beside it.
purpose: An app screen with three ways to get help, a chat that hands off from AI to a person in the same thread, and a side panel of past conversations and endpoint status. An incident shows as a banner in the chat. Out of hours the chat says support is away; with no history it starts a fresh chat; a failing service says which part failed.
useWhen: People need help from the AI first and a person second, without losing the thread.
Their earlier conversations and the state of the service belong beside the chat.

avoidWhen.when: The page is a public record of uptime and incidents.
The person decides a request an agent or a customer sent.

states.name: default
states.how: an incident banner in the chat, the AI online, a person available, four conversations

states.name: empty
states.how: ?state=empty: a fresh chat, an empty history with a hint

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: the chat, history and status each fail with Retry or a link

states.name: after hours
states.how: ?state=after-hours: the person card says Offline, the chat shows its away view
